info.name: arTaH
info.note: saNGAtaH ityukte granTitfvyApAraH (to write or to compose), taTA ca granTavyApAraH (the one that is written or composed) .

info.name: hindI arTa
info.value: Sloka banAnA, kavitA karanA, racanA karanA

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: saNGAtaH= granTaH ' iti sAyaRaH . ' saNGAte varjane sarjane ' iti vopadevaH . ' saNGAte - saMhanane, saMhanyamAne ca' iti kzIrasvAmI . ' saNGAto granTaH . sa ceha graTyamAnavyApAraH ' iti svAmyAdayaH . kASyapAdayastu granTitfvyApAraH iti graTnAtivat sakarmakaH iti ' DAtuvfttO uktam . ' sa ceha graTyamAnasya vyApAro granTiturvA . Adyekarmako dvitIye sakarmakaH ' iti sidDAntakOmudI .

examples: 'upaSlokyasya mAhAtmyAdujjvalAH kAvyasampadaH' (BA0 kAvyA0 ). upaSlokyaH stutyaH kIrtyaH.
